title: aggregate artifact origins into release index for private-installer
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Add cross-repo artifact origin aggregation to release index used by private-installer; includes pipeline changes, index schema extension, signature/verification cross-checks, and docs for operator consumption.
description:
Context and motivation: Private-installer releases consume artifacts produced by multiple build pipelines (core runtime, helm charts, terraform modules, third-party vendor artifacts). Existing release index entries pointed to single build blobs but lost origin metadata (repo/build-job/container image digest). This PR extends the release index generation to aggregate origin provenance across repos/pipelines so operators can inspect where each artifact came from and verify chain-of-custody at install time.

What this PR does: - Adds an `origins` aggregate block to the release index JSON that lists source repository, pipeline job id, build commit, and optional SBOM/cosign references per artifact. - Modifies the private-installer indexer job to query multiple artifact registries and cross-reference artifact digests to upstream build metadata (via the new origin-mapper service). - Adds origin-mapper microservice (lightweight Go lambda) that merges build metadata across internal buildkite/jenkins/job-run APIs and returns a normalized origin statement for an artifact digest. - Updates CI/CD pipelines: new step in release pipeline to call origin-mapper and attach signed origin blobs to TUF/manifest staging area. - Enhances verification: indexer validates cosign signatures on origin blobs (if present) and records signature verification result in the index. - Adds operator docs and an index API example in private-installer docs for auditors to query artifact origins during upgrades/rollbacks.

Checklist (implemented): - [x] Extend release index schema (index-schema/v2) with `origins` field and verification metadata - [x] Origin-mapper service implementation and unit tests - [x] Release pipeline changes (buildkite/jenkins) to emit origin blobs - [x] Indexer changes in private-installer repo to consume origin blobs - [x] Add integration test that replays multi-repo build metadata into staging index - [x] Docs: private-installer operator guide section on origin queries - [x] Security review: minimal privileges for origin-mapper to query job metadata APIs

Commits (high-level): - feat(indexer): add origin mapping hooks and schema v2 metadata - feat(origin-mapper): initial service with buildkite and jenkins adapters - ci(release): add origin-stage and sign-origin steps, upload to staging TUF area - docs(installer): add operator guide and example queries - test(integration): multi-repo origin aggregation smoke test - fix(ci): tolerate missing SBOM references for third-party mirrored artifacts

Files/areas changed (high-level): - private-installer/cmd/indexer: indexer changed to call origin-mapper and persist origins into index JSON - private-installer/internal/index/schema_v2.go: new schema and JSON marshaling changes - tools/origin-mapper/: new Go service and adapters for buildkite/jenkins - infra/ci/pipelines/release.yml: added origin-stage, sign-origin and upload steps - docs/private-installer/origins.md: operator documentation and API examples - charts/private-installer/values.yaml: small annotation for chart provenance - scripts/dev/replay-origins.sh: local dev helper to simulate upstream metadata

Review conversation (summary): - Lina: "Nice; can we guarantee origin-mapper rate limits won't blow up during a large release?" Author: "Origin-mapper queues queries and caches job metadata for 24h; added circuit-breaker and bulk query path. See origin-mapper/README for eviction rules." - Ethan: "Add tests for mirrored artifacts where upstream job metadata is absent." Author: "Added integration test that marks missing upstream metadata and attaches best-effort origin assertion with source:mirror and mirror-ref." - Zoe: "Signature verification path looks good, but require operator flag to enforce failed verification as hard-fail for critical releases." Author: "Added CLI flag `--enforce-origin-verification` to indexer and documented recommended usage in docs." - Security review (internal): "Ensure origin-mapper tokens scoped read-only and short lived." Author: "Confirmed; CI injects ephemeral tokens, and service uses read-only tokens with minimal TTL. Details in infra/ci/README-security.md."

CI summary: - Initial run: integration tests failed due to missing adapter for legacy Jenkins job API (fixed in second commit). - Second run: unit + integration + lint passed. - E2E staging run: origin blobs uploaded and cosign verification passed for signed artifacts; unsigned third-party artifacts recorded with `verified:false`. Final ci_status: pass.

Edge cases and limitations: - For artifacts mirrored from external vendors we may not retrieve upstream build job metadata; index will include `source: mirror` and a pointer to mirror provenance where available. - This PR does not change TUF signing policy; origin blobs themselves are uploaded to staging and signed with cosign in the release pipeline. TUF package signing remains the authoritative release signature. - Performance: origin-mapper adds an extra ~200-400ms per artifact during index generation in current staging; indexer runs concurrently and batching mitigates impact in typical releases.

Migration and rollout plan: - Index schema v2 is backward-compatible: indexer writes `schema_version: 2` and tooling falls back to v1 when v2 entry not present. - Rollout: release pipeline will emit v2 indexes to a staging bucket for two release cycles; operator tooling supports reading v1 and v2. - Post-merge action: update release-runbooks and notify SRE and compliance teams to start auditing origin queries on next private-installer release.

Merge outcome: Approved by Lina and Zoe after two rounds of review and tests; merged via squash on 2025-11-12.

Notes for future work: - Consider adding signed SBOM references into origin blobs for deeper attestation. - Explore offloading origin metadata to a dedicated provenance catalog service with search capabilities.
